body.html: BM Pattani Apartment is an apartment building that takes overnight guests on a daily-rental basis, set in the Rusamilae area on Charoen Pradit Road in Mueang Pattani · The headline draw that guests mention again and again is the location — it's close to Prince of Songkla University's Pattani campus, within an easy walk of restaurants, a 7-Eleven and a mini Big C · That makes it a natural pick for parents visiting students, people coming for exams or seminars, or anyone with business near the university who wants a budget room with simple parking.

Rooms here are plain but cleaner than the price suggests, which is the phrase that shows up most often in reviews · A standard room comes with a comfortable bed, a flat-screen TV, a fridge, a work desk, a wardrobe with a lockable section, free drinking water and a small balcony for drying laundry · The bathroom has a water heater plus liquid soap and shampoo · Some rooms even come with a prayer mat and a marked qibla direction, a detail Muslim guests appreciate · Every room has air-conditioning and free Wi-Fi.
"Very clean room, great value for money, plenty of parking, and friendly staff who even recommended places to eat and visit around Pattani. Easy walk to 7-Eleven and restaurants."

On the practical side, the property offers free parking on a roomy lot, a lift, laundry service and daily housekeeping · The uncrowded parking area is a real plus for self-drivers, since finding a spot around the university during term can be a chore · Staff earn praise for being friendly and for pointing guests toward good food and sights in Pattani · With restaurants, a 7-Eleven and a night market all within walking distance, you don't have to drive far when you're hungry.

To be straight with you, this is a budget apartment rather than a full-service hotel, so there are limits worth knowing before you book · There's no breakfast, no swimming pool, and no 24-hour front desk like a larger hotel, so confirm your check-in time with the property in advance · Some reviews note the rooms aren't well soundproofed, so you may hear neighbours or the corridor at night · A few bathrooms lack a shower curtain, so water can splash · Room quality can also be a little inconsistent — some more recent reviews mention cleanliness slipping in spots, such as bed linen not being changed or balcony areas left untended.

Location is the other thing to weigh up · Rusamilae sits a bit toward the edge of town and isn't in the Anoru old-town core · If your trip is built around walking the markets, grazing the old-town food scene, or visiting the Lim Ko Niao Shrine at night, having your own vehicle helps a lot, since the old town is around 10 minutes' drive away · But if you already have a car and your main business is near PSU Pattani, this location fits nicely.

Overall, BM Pattani Apartment suits budget-minded travellers who value cleanliness, a location near the university and easy parking over plush facilities · With a score of around 9.0 on Trip.com and fairly consistent feedback on value and cleanliness, it's a sensible budget choice for a stay near PSU Pattani — as long as you know you're booking a simple apartment and aren't expecting hotel-style service.
